query: What are the thematic fields covered by Horizon Europe?
response:
Horizon Europe (€95.5 billion) is structured around three main Pillars, each covering distinct thematic fields. The majority of collaborative, challenge-driven research funding is organized under **Pillar II: Global Challenges and European Industrial Competitiveness** through six thematic Clusters and five EU Missions.

### 1. Pillar I: Excellent Science
This pillar funds foundational, frontier research, focusing on scientific excellence and researcher mobility, rather than specific predefined thematic targets.

| Action Type | Focus | Key Feature |
|-------------|-------|-------------|
| **ERC** | Frontier Research | Investigator-driven, bottom-up (any field) |
| **MSCA** | Researcher Mobility & Training | Thematic-neutral, covering all research fields |
| **Research Infrastructures** | Access and development of high-quality facilities | Focus on physical and virtual research environments |

### 2. Pillar II: Global Challenges and European Industrial Competitiveness
This is the primary area for thematic and collaborative research addressing societal challenges and European strategic goals. It is divided into **6 Thematic Clusters** and **5 EU Missions**.

#### The 6 Thematic Clusters
The Clusters define the core thematic fields, each having a dedicated Work Programme with specific calls (RIA, IA, CSA):

| Cluster | Name | Core Thematic Fields |
|---------|------|-----------------------|
| **Cluster 1** | **Health** | Disease prevention, treatment, healthcare systems, pandemic preparedness, personalized medicine. |
| **Cluster 2** | **Culture, Creativity & Inclusive Society** | Democracy, governance, cultural heritage, social cohesion, digital transformation of society. |
| **Cluster 3** | **Civil Security for Society** | Cybersecurity, disaster resilience, border management, infrastructure protection, counter-terrorism. |
| **Cluster 4** | **Digital, Industry & Space** | AI, robotics, advanced manufacturing, quantum computing, key enabling technologies, satellite systems. |
| **Cluster 5** | **Climate, Energy & Mobility** | Clean energy transition, hydrogen, batteries, sustainable transport, climate science, decarbonisation. |
| **Cluster 6** | **Food, Bioeconomy, Natural Resources, Agriculture & Environment** | Sustainable farming, biodiversity, circular economy, healthy oceans/waters, soil health, forestry. |

#### The 5 EU Missions
These are portfolios of research and innovation actions targeting ambitious, measurable goals by 2030, cutting across the Clusters where necessary:

1.  **Cancer:** Improve the lives of 3+ million people through prevention, cure, and better quality of life.
2.  **Climate Adaptation:** Support 150+ EU regions to become climate-resilient by 2030.
3.  **Ocean & Waters:** Restore the health of our ocean and waters by 2030.
4.  **Cities:** 100 European cities climate-neutral by 2030.
5.  **Soil:** A Soil Deal for Europe: 100 living labs and lighthouses for healthy soils by 2030.

### 3. Pillar III: Innovative Europe
This pillar focuses on bringing breakthrough innovations to the market, supporting SMEs and the wider innovation ecosystem.

| Action Type | Focus | Key Feature |
|-------------|-------|-------------|
| **EIC** | European Innovation Council | Funds market-creating innovation (Pathfinder, Transition, Accelerator) |
| **EIT** | European Institute of Innovation & Technology | Focus on integrating education, research, and business (KICs) |

***

### 🎯 Getting Started with Horizon Europe:
To find specific calls within these thematic fields, follow these steps:

• Register on [EU Funding & Tenders Portal](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/home)
• Review the [Work Programmes](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents;programCode=HORIZON) for your cluster
• Check eligibility via [How to Participate](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/how-to-participate/1)
• Find partners using [Partner Search](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/partner-search)
• Browse [Call Calendar](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/calls-calendar)
